summary: Tested comprehensive contrast fixes across DiaGyn, Pharmacy (Orange), Home, and Doctor Detail Modal pages in both light and dark modes. All contrast fixes verified working correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: DiaGynRedesigned.js correctly implements isDarkMode theme awareness with warm cream #F0EBE3 background in light mode
How to Book card uses clay styling in light mode (boxShadow with double shadow pattern) and glassmorphism in dark mode
Hero heading 'Book Your Doctor Any Time Any Where' correctly uses dark text (#1C1917) in light mode and white in dark mode
OrangeMedcare.js fully theme-aware with isDarkMode support - background, text colors, card styling all respect theme
DoctorDetailModal.jsx correctly renders single full-width Pushpa Clinic button (324px width) instead of half-width toggle
Booking progress steps text uses 0.55 opacity for undone steps (rgba(255,255,255,0.55)) - improved from 0.35
ServiceHeader.jsx inactive tabs correctly use warm sandy background rgba(240,235,227,0.7) in light mode
Home.js clay styles object properly applied with card, btn, pill, header, activePill variants in light mode only
MyOrders.jsx has clay styling for order cards, filter pills, and Track Order button in light mode
seed_data_creation: None required - existing test data used
context_for_next_testing_agent: Comprehensive contrast fixes applied across all pages. Light mode uses warm cream #F0EBE3 background with claymorphism (double shadow pattern). Dark mode uses #050510 background with glassmorphism. Doctor Detail Modal shows single full-width clinic button when only one physical clinic exists. Text contrast improved with 0.55 opacity for muted text.
